sections.title: Special Events
items: Heist Event week runs from November 5 through November 11.
Logging in during the event unlocks The Great Circle Back Mansion Painting Decoration.
Your first run of The Cayo Perico Heist has the Panther Statue locked in as the Primary Target.
Your first run of The Kortz Center Heist has The Outcome of Endeavour painting locked in as the Primary Target.
Weekly Challenge: a single Adversary Mode win pays GTA$100,000.
The Great Circle Back Mansion Painting Decoration is a free unlock for any player who logs in to GTA Online between November 5 and November 11.
No mission, race or purchase is needed to claim it.
